what_changed: Marlow Metalworks cannot ship the full PO-5520 (200 BL-12 boilers) on the original day-7 date, and offers either a split shipment (80 on day 7, 120 on day 21) or a full shipment of 200 on day 13.

options.name: Option A: 80 on day 7 + 120 on day 21

decisions_for_a_person: Choose between Option A (delays order O-2205, 4 days late, penalty applies) and Option B (delays order O-2203, 1 day late, penalty applies) within three business days, or Marlow will default to Option B.

Consider which late-penalty order is more costly/important to prioritize: O-2203 (Elm State University Dining, 40 units short, 1 day late) vs O-2205 (Tall Pines Coffee House, 5 units short, 4 days late).
